---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for FFD
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / Motivation

Describe the problem, limitation, or inconvenience you're experiencing.

**Example:**

Currently, FFD doesn't provide an easy way to limit download speeds. This makes it difficult to control bandwidth usage when downloading large files.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature or improvement you'd like to see.

**Example:**

Add a `--limit-rate` flag that allows users to specify the maximum download speed.

For example:

`ffd https://example.com/file.zip --limit-rate 2MB/s`

## Alternatives

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

**Example:**

Currently, I have to use an external bandwidth limiting tool to control FFD's download speed.

## Use Case

Explain when and how this feature would be useful.

**Example:**

Users with limited bandwidth could download files without consuming their entire internet connection.

## Additional Context

Add any other information, references, or examples that could help explain your proposal.
